All 13 pre-election RCP records are marked historical/stale and excluded by the existing model's status eligibility rules. Publication/fieldwork dates were preserved. Kalshi API request was blocked with environment HTTP 403; Sabato and Cook returned HTTP 403. All 39 blocked-source values and original fetched/publication dates were retained, with updated attempt timestamps. Individual-poll subset, application code, candidates and personal history were not modified.
